# RX Tracker NEXT 4.0.0-next.59

## Project Control test-copy activation correction

- Fixed Project Control option 25 activation and automatic recovery when NSSM
  retains an older test-copy database in its multi-value service environment.
- The guarded workflow now clears `AppEnvironmentExtra` before writing the
  exact `.env` snapshot and one-time health token. It then reads the service
  configuration back and requires exactly one matching `DB_NAME` before the
  service can start.
- This prevents duplicate old/new database values such as a prior
  `patient_rx_restore_restore_test_2` target from blocking activation of a
  newly verified `patient_rx_restore_test` copy.

## Safety

- Exact database, service executable, process, listener, runtime-role,
  migration, checksum-ledger, and one-time local health checks remain enforced.
- The already restored isolated database is not altered by this correction.
- No schema migration, business-data rewrite, production GUI restore change,
  or Kasm, Cloudflare, CORS, cookie, HTTPS, trust-proxy, or reverse-proxy
  change.
- Validate option 25 again on the testing server before any separately
  approved production update.
